name: Ha Long food guide
summary: Ha Long eats squid cake on the boats and at Tết, then a morning bowl of bún bề bề or bún cù kỳ. Sữa chua trân châu and bánh trôi tàu are the sweets. Rượu ngán is the drink with the seafood. Sá sùng is Quan Lạn. Bánh gật gù is Tiên Yên.
body: Eat Hạ Long for chả mực. Chuyên trang du lịch Quảng Ninh puts the squid cake on the cruise boats, at provincial banquets, and on the Tết table, and names xôi chả mực and bún cù kỳ Hạ Long beside it. Báo Quảng Ninh, 13 Mar 2019, describes bún bề bề, the cù kỳ bowl, and the afternoon blood-and-balut. VnExpress, 16 Mar 2021, adds bánh cuốn chả mực, cháo trai, the seafood noodles, sam, ốc xào dừa, and the two sweets. Báo Quảng Ninh, 9 Jul 2015, is the home-style seafood meal: grilled and boiled shellfish, three sour soups, and rượu ngán.

The seafood market under Núi Bài Thơ runs from 4:30 and is done before 7:00, on Báo Quảng Ninh, 6 May 2020. Friday and Saturday, phố đi bộ Bài Thơ runs 18:00–24:00. Công luận also says holidays and Tết. A current stall price was not printed. Check on arrival. Chuyên trang du lịch Quảng Ninh places sá sùng at Quan Lạn and Vân Đồn, mực một nắng at Cô Tô, and ruốc at Quảng Yên. Báo Quảng Ninh, 6 May 2020, still lists mực một nắng and ruốc tôm among gifts at chợ Hạ Long 1 and 2. Both stay. VnExpress places bánh gật gù at Tiên Yên, and the English edition of Báo Quảng Ninh says the same. It is not a Hạ Long plate.
specialtiesLead: Thirty-two plates are named for Hạ Long. The photograph is the fried squid cakes. A current stall price on every line is Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Specialties
highlights: Bún hải sản and bánh đa hải sản
Hải sản at Bãi Cháy and Hạ Long
Bề bề hấp or rang muối
Sò huyết nướng or luộc làm lông
paragraphs: Chả mực is the plate with a photograph. The other names follow: the rice with the cake, the morning noodles, the home-style seafood from Báo Quảng Ninh, 9 Jul 2015, then the sweets and rượu ngán.
Prices printed in 2019, 2020, and 2021 stay with the year and the publisher. A current stall price was not printed. Check on arrival. Where two prices were printed, both stay.

sections.heading: International dining
paragraphs: The operator guide for Sun World Hạ Long, at Số 9 đường Hạ Long in phường Bãi Cháy, names a sushi counter and two grill lines on a buffet. No room photograph was used here. A price for the sushi, the cocktail, or those grill lines was not printed. Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Casual dining
paragraphs: The casual doors are streets and counters, not a ranked shop list. Phố đi bộ Bài Thơ runs 18:00–24:00 on Friday and Saturday. Công luận also says holidays and Tết. Dân trí does not. Both stay. The 2023 reports say phường Bạch Đằng. The 2025 resolution puts Bạch Đằng in phường Hồng Gai. On the Bãi Cháy side, Chuyên trang du lịch Quảng Ninh groups phố đi bộ Bãi Cháy, chợ đêm Hạ Long, and Sun Carnival Plaza after dark, and prints no hour.

The fast-food counter is inside Sun World, not on those streets. A stall price was not printed. Check on arrival. Báo Quảng Ninh, 6 May 2020, adds the seafood market under Núi Bài Thơ, open from 4:30 and done before 7:00, and places chợ Hạ Long 2 on đường Lê Lợi. Cổng thông tin Quảng Ninh adds VuiFest in phường Bãi Cháy. An open hour for VuiFest was not printed. Check on arrival.

spots.address: Long Tiên and Lê Quý Đôn. 2023 reports say phường Bạch Đằng. From 2025 that ward is inside phường Hồng Gai.
spots.note: Seafood and street food. About 50 stalls at the opening, including OCOP, on the Dân trí report. Công luận adds OCOP. Nearly 400 m, 17 tổ, more than 500 households on Công luận. Dân trí does not print the length. 18:00–24:00 Friday and Saturday. Công luận also says holidays and Tết. A stall price was not printed. Check on arrival.

spots.address: Under Núi Bài Thơ
spots.note: Báo Quảng Ninh, 6 May 2020, calls this the city’s main live-seafood market. It runs from 4:30 and is done before 7:00. The article names tôm, mực, bề bề, sò huyết, and cá song, packed on ice to take home. A price was not printed. Check on arrival.

spots.address: Đường Lê Lợi
spots.note: Báo Quảng Ninh, 6 May 2020, places it about 1 km from chợ Hạ Long 1 on đường Bạch Đằng. Gifts named there are fresh chả mực pounded at the shops, ruốc tôm, mực một nắng, and mực rim me. Chuyên trang du lịch Quảng Ninh places mực một nắng at Cô Tô and ruốc at Quảng Yên. Both stay. A daytime hour was not printed. Check on arrival.

spots.address: Phường Bãi Cháy
spots.note: Cổng thông tin Quảng Ninh says this night-market street opened in early July, without a year in the lines read here, with nearly 100 tents and 40 stalls. It names bánh cuốn chả mực, fresh seafood, and sữa chua trân châu. An open hour was not printed. Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Themed dining
paragraphs: Themed eating on the opened pages is the Dragon Park buffet, the set meals tied to the cable car and the fireworks, the 2024 beer-and-squid-cake festival, and the squid cake on the cruise boats. No boat brand is a pick. A buffet price, apart from the cable-car combos below, was not printed.

The combos are tickets, not a stall price. Queen cable car plus the food set is 450,000 đồng for an adult and 350,000 for a child. Queen cable car plus the VUI-Fest set is 650,000 and 550,000. Queen cable car plus the Bavaria set is 750,000 and 650,000. The basic cable table defines a child as 1 m–1.4 m. These combo lines say trẻ em and do not repeat the height.

spots.note: The first time, over the 30 Apr–1 May 2024 holiday. Visitors were seated, looked at a record squid cake, and were served chả mực and beer free. Do not extend the free line to another year. The next date is Check on arrival. The cruise boats also serve chả mực. No boat brand is named.

sections.heading: Breakfast
paragraphs: Bún bề bề, bún cù kỳ, bánh cuốn chả mực, cháo trai, and bún hải sản are morning plates. Phở is the other breakfast Báo Quảng Ninh, 13 Mar 2019, names in the city center and at Bãi Cháy. Cổng thông tin Quảng Ninh quotes a visitor who adds phở tôm to a morning list with bún, bề bề, and cù kỳ. A broth for that bowl was not printed.

spots.name: Pho
spots.address: The center of Hạ Long, and Bãi Cháy
spots.note: Báo Quảng Ninh, 13 Mar 2019, calls it a common breakfast and names a shop on Trần Hưng Đạo. A garnish was not printed. That article printed about 50,000 đồng a bowl. A current price is Check on arrival.

seoTitle: Ha Long food — squid cake, morning noodles, and rượu ngán
seoDescription: Eat chả mực hot with rice sheets or rice, then bún bề bề or bún cù kỳ. Sữa chua trân châu and bánh trôi tàu are the sweets. A current stall price is Check on arrival.
